def canary_iids(seed, window_id, scope_id, net64_str):
    data = ("ipv6-evidence-v1\n%d\n%s\n%s\n%s\n" % (seed, window_id, scope_id, net64_str)).encode("ascii")

    c0 = int.from_bytes(digest[:8], "big") | (1 << 63)
    return c0, c0 ^ 1

import hashlib, ipaddress
def canaries(seed, w, s, net64):
